transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ___. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I've been making some mistakes at work. I'm a camera operator and editor, and lately, I just keep doing these dumb technical things that I know better than to do. Like... labeling camera cards wrong, or missing a timecode note. I even exported a client cut the other day with the wrong lower-third on it, and I swear I had already checked it. It just... it kind of scared me into finally coming in.
Did you have similar attention or careless mistakes like this when you were a child, before age 12?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Even back in elementary school, my teachers... they used to have to move my desk a lot. I was just always getting out of my seat, or... blurting out answers. I'd end up bothering the other kids before I even really realized I was doing it. So... yeah.
When did these work mistakes and attention problems start—have they been going on since childhood, or did they begin only recently?

Well... the mistakes at work, they haven't always been this bad. I mean, it's been going on at this level for... I guess about two years and two months. 

There was a... a company readjustment back then. It changed how my shoots and edit reviews run. So... yeah, it's been more of a problem since then.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless nearly every day?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I'm frustrated about the mistakes at work, but... no. Not depressed.
Have you been feeling anxious or worrying excessively about different things most days?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I worry about normal things, I guess, but... not excessively. Just regular stress.
Was there a particular stressful event around the time these work problems worsened?
Um... no. Not really. Just the... the company readjustment I already mentioned. I can't think of anything else.
